answer_1.quote: This work aims to highlight the importance of evaluating the reliability and provenance of arguments in comparative answers generated by RAG-style methods.

answer_2.quote: To assess the relevance and faithfulness of the collected summaries, we employ the following evaluation metrics: • Jaccard similarity & Levenstein distance... • Semantic similarity... • Argument Relevance (AR): Precision (AR), Recall (AR), F1... • Argument-Answer Coherence (AAC)...

answer_3.quote: We use the GPT-4 model to check whether the citation supports the correct object...

answer_4.quote: Five expert annotators, each holding at least an MSc degree in linguistics or computational linguistics, were asked to assign relevance scores to batches of 100 sentences.
